name: Jiu Niangzi
bio: Archetype: ST DPT, Extra Action. ⌽ Accumulates [Liquor] based on the number of unique buffs held by all allies and by using S2. ⌽ While holding [Liquor], gains a random buff at the start of the round. ⌽ After attacking with S1, consumes a random amount of [Liquor] to cast a FUA based on the amount of [Liquor] consumed. ⌽ Ult deals additional damage the fewer targets there are; replenishes/consumes [Liquor] based on current stack. ⌽ When casting Ult while holding 6+ [Liquor], consume [Liquor] to gain additional Penetration Rate. ⌽ When casting Ult while holding less than 6 [Liquor], gain 6 stacks of [Liqour].
